label: Scan information
tooltip: Shows the size and condition of the scan.
nonManifoldEdges: Edges with more than two triangles
repairHint: Repair removes triangles without area and duplicate triangles and makes the orientation consistent.
smallPartsHint: Remove small parts deletes the loose parts.
help: The values refer to the current scan and are updated after every change. Holes and open edges do not disturb fitting; a volume exists only for closed scans.
